Installed inline, the filter screens out suspended debris such as sand, algae and other particles before they can reach emitters and contribute to clogging. It features a black plastic housing, 2-inch male threaded connections, a bottom drain and a removable mesh screen that can be rinsed for routine maintenance. For a typical setup, install the filter on the irrigation main line after the pump and before distribution lines, while ensuring the connection type, flow rate and filtration mesh suit your system. Check for leaks after installation and clean the screen as needed; a dirty element can restrict flow and reduce irrigation performance. The screen filter is a useful component for farm irrigation, gardens and other water-delivery systems using compatible fittings. Confirm operating pressure and system compatibility before purchase. This product is a screen filter, not a guarantee that every water contaminant will be removed. Shop the 2-inch irrigation mesh screen filter from SterMont Arcade to support dependable drip and sprinkler irrigation maintenance.

item.title: Jambo Clean Foliar Fertilizer
item.description: ## Product Overview & Key Benefits Greenlife Jambo Clean Foliar Fertilizer (1 Litre) Greenlife Jambo Clean is a foliar fertilizer that cleans sooty mould and honeydew off crops while nourishing them. It contains water-soluble phosphorus pentoxide (P2O5) 8.2% and total nitrogen 10.0% (urea 8.5% plus ammoniacal 1.5%). It is supplied in a 1 litre pack. - Foliar fertilizer that cleans sooty mould and honeydew - Water-soluble phosphorus pentoxide (P2O5) 8.2% - Total nitrogen 10.0% (urea 8.5% + ammoniacal 1.5%) - Feeds the crop while it cleans the leaves - 1 litre pack - Greenlife brand - Delivered to all 47 counties WHAT ARE HONEYDEW AND SOOTY MOULD? Sucking insects such as aphids, whiteflies and scale insects feed on plant sap and pass out a sticky, sugary liquid called honeydew. It covers leaves, stems and fruits. A black fungus called sooty mould then grows on the honeydew and forms a dark coating. The coating blocks light, so the plant cannot photosynthesise well, and it makes the crop look dirty, which can lower quality and market value, especially for flowers, vegetables and fruit. HOW JAMBO CLEAN HELPS Jambo Clean is sprayed on the crop to help clean off sooty mould and honeydew. At the same time, the nutrients in the product nourish the plant. This makes it a practical choice for growers who need to clean up their crops and give them a boost. WHAT THE NUTRIENTS DO - Nitrogen supports leaf growth and green colour. Here it comes partly as urea and partly as ammoniacal nitrogen - Phosphorus supports root development, flowering and energy transfer in the plant ## Safety, Storage & Handling Guidelines Read the label before use. Wear gloves and avoid contact with eyes and skin. Keep away from children, pets, food and water. Do not let spray or rinse water reach streams or ponds. Store in the original closed bottle in a cool, dry place away from food and feed. Read the product label and follow the stated crop, rate, mixing, timing and handling instructions. Wear the protective clothing and gloves specified by the manufacturer; avoid contact with eyes and skin and avoid breathing dust, mist or vapour. Do not exceed the recommended application rate or mix with other products unless the label permits it. Keep in the original closed container, away from children, food, drink, animal feed and water sources. Prevent spills from entering drains or waterways and follow the label and local rules for disposal. If irritation or accidental exposure occurs, follow the label first-aid instructions and seek medical advice when needed. ## Delivery across Kenya & Nairobi Pickup Order Jambo Clean online, pay by M-Pesa and get delivery to all 47 counties, or pick up at The Sarit Centre, Westlands, Nairobi. Shop Jambo Clean Foliar Fertilizer in Kenya at Stermont Arcade. ## How to use Follow the dose, water volume, timing and interval given on the label. Mix in clean water, agitate, and spray evenly so that leaves are well covered. Spray in the cool of the morning or late afternoon and avoid the heat of the day to reduce the risk of leaf scorch. Test on a few plants first if you are using it on a crop for the first time. IMPORTANT: TREAT THE CAUSE TOO Sooty mould returns if the sucking insects are still there. Scout for aphids, whiteflies and scale and control them with a suitable insecticide, following its label. Good crop hygiene, ant control and removing badly affected leaves also help.

item.title: Kerol Disinfectant Fluid (1L)
item.description: ## Product Overview & Key Benefits Kerol Disinfectant Fluid (1 Litre) Kerol Disinfectant Fluid has a Rideal-Walker coefficient of 18 to 20 and is a powerful disinfectant and insect repellent for livestock houses, poultry houses and domestic use. It comes in a 1 litre pack and is diluted with water as directed on the label. - Rideal-Walker coefficient 18 to 20 - Powerful disinfectant - Also acts as an insect repellent - For livestock houses, poultry houses and domestic use - Dilute with water before use - 1 litre pack - Delivered to all 47 counties WHAT THE RIDEAL-WALKER COEFFICIENT MEANS The Rideal-Walker coefficient is a traditional way of comparing the germ-killing strength of a disinfectant with phenol, which is given a value of 1. A coefficient of 18 to 20 means the fluid is many times stronger than phenol when tested under standard laboratory conditions, which is why it is described as a powerful disinfectant. Real results depend on dilution, contact time and how clean the surface is. WHERE IT IS USED - Livestock houses: cattle sheds, milking parlours, goat and sheep pens and pig sties - Poultry houses: brooders, layer and broiler houses, and equipment - Domestic use: floors, drains, toilets, bins and other places that need disinfecting WHY DISINFECTION MATTERS Germs build up where animals live and where waste collects. Regular cleaning and disinfection lowers the risk of disease spreading in a herd or flock, protects young animals, and keeps houses fresher and smell-free. In the home, it helps keep drains, bathrooms and bins clean. ## Safety, Storage & Handling Guidelines Read the label before use. Wear gloves, goggles and protective clothing, and avoid contact with eyes and skin. Keep away from children, pets, food and drinking water. Do not let large amounts reach streams or ponds. item.title: BioDistinction Extra 700SC Copper Fertilizer
item.description: ## Product Overview & Key Benefits Greenlife BioDistinction Extra 700SC Copper Fertilizer (1 Litre) Greenlife BioDistinction Extra 700SC is a liquid chelated copper suspension concentrate fertilizer. It contains copper oxychloride 700 g/L, which is 400 g/L metallic copper equivalent, and it corrects and prevents copper deficiency in vegetables, fruit, cereals and ornamentals. It is supplied in a 1 litre pack. - Liquid chelated copper fertilizer in suspension concentrate (SC) form - Copper oxychloride 700 g/L (400 g/L metallic copper equivalent) - Corrects and prevents copper deficiency - For vegetables, fruit, cereals and ornamentals - 1 litre pack - Greenlife brand WHY COPPER MATTERS Copper is a trace element that plants need in small amounts. It plays a part in enzyme activity, in the formation of chlorophyll and in flowering, pollen formation and grain filling. When copper is short, plants can show stunted growth, pale or twisted young leaves, poor flowering and lower yields. Cereals are especially sensitive, and deficiencies are more common in sandy, peaty and very high-organic soils. ## Safety, Storage & Handling Guidelines Read the label before use. Wear gloves, a mask, goggles and protective clothing when mixing and spraying, and wash well afterwards. Keep away from children, pets, food and water. Copper compounds can be harmful to fish and aquatic life, so keep spray and rinse water out of streams, ponds and drains. Store in the original closed bottle in a cool, dry place away from food and feed. Shake well before use. This is a pest-control or agricultural chemical product. Use it only for the crop, pest, site and application method expressly authorised on the current Kenya-approved product label. Read the full label before opening or use. Follow the label exactly for personal protective equipment, dilution, application, ventilation, re-entry period, pre-harvest interval, environmental restrictions and any other precautions. Do not guess a dose, mix it with another product, or use it on food, animals, people or surfaces unless the label specifically permits that use. Keep the original container tightly closed and locked away from children, unauthorised persons and animals, and separate from food, drink and animal feed. Prevent spills and contamination of drains, wells, streams and other water sources. Do not eat, drink or smoke while handling; wash hands and exposed skin after handling. Never reuse an empty pesticide container; follow the label and approved local hazardous-waste collection or disposal instructions. In case of suspected poisoning or significant exposure, seek urgent medical attention and show the product label. Kenya PCPB poison information hotlines listed in its labelling guidance: 0800 720 021 or 0800 730 030. ## Delivery across Kenya & Nairobi Pickup Order BioDistinction Extra 700SC online, pay by M-Pesa and get delivery to all 47 counties, or pick up at The Sarit Centre, Westlands, Nairobi. ## How to use Apply as directed on the label, normally as a foliar spray, using the dose and water volume recommended for your crop. Mix by half-filling the tank with water, adding the measured product, topping up and agitating well. Spray evenly, covering the leaves. Apply when the crop is actively growing and at the stage recommended on the label, and spray early in the morning or late in the afternoon when it is cooler. If you are unsure whether copper is really short, consider a soil or leaf test to confirm. GOOD PRACTICE - Do not exceed the label rate, because too much copper can harm plants and soil - Avoid spraying in hot midday sun - Test a small area first if you plan to mix with other products - Keep records of dates and doses

item.title: Weed-Out 480SL Glyphosate Herbicide
item.description: ## Product Overview & Key Benefits Weed-Out 480SL Glyphosate Herbicide (5 litres) Clearing a plot, fence line, compound or farm before planting by hand takes days and costs a lot in labour. Weed-Out 480SL is a non-selective, systemic glyphosate herbicide that is absorbed through the leaves and travels down to the roots, so grasses and broadleaf weeds die instead of regrowing. The 5-litre pack suits farmers, estate caretakers and contractors who clear land often. KEY BENEFITS - Systemic action kills the roots, which means less regrowth than slashing or hoeing - Controls annual and perennial grasses and broadleaf weeds, including tough couch grass - Saves labour on land preparation, zero-tillage planting, fence lines, paths and compounds - Economical: 5 L makes 16 to 25 knapsack loads depending on the weed - Rain-free period is short, so you can spray on the next dry morning TECHNICAL SPECS - Active ingredient: Glyphosate 480 g/L - Formulation: Soluble liquid (SL) - Type: Non-selective, post-emergence, systemic herbicide - Pack: 5 litres MIXING AND APPLICATION DOSAGE (per 20 L knapsack) - Young broadleaf weeds and annual grasses: 200 ml (5 L pack makes 25 knapsacks) - Perennial grasses such as couch grass: 300 ml (5 L pack makes about 16 knapsacks) At about 4 L per hectare in 200 L of water (200 ml per 20 L), one 5 L pack treats roughly 1 hectare. Always confirm the rate on your pack's label. 1. Use clean water. Half-fill the knapsack, add Weed-Out, then top up to 20 L and shake. 2. Spray actively growing weeds until the leaves are wet but not dripping. 3. Expect yellowing within a few days and root die-off soon after. 4. Avoid spraying if rain is expected within 4 to 6 hours. ## Safety, Storage & Handling Guidelines It kills any green plant it touches, so shield crops and avoid drift in wind. Keep away from water sources. Wear gloves, overalls and a face mask. Rinse the sprayer very thoroughly afterwards, or keep a separate sprayer for herbicides. item.title: Amaze Fridge and Freezer Guard with Extension
item.description: ## Product Overview & Key Benefits Buy the Amaze Fridge and Freezer Guard with a 6-way extension socket online in Kenya. Power cuts, sudden returns of electricity and low voltage are some of the most common reasons fridge compressors fail. This guard sits between your wall socket and your fridge or freezer, watches the supply, and cuts the power when it is unsafe so your appliance is not damaged. How it works: the guard has three indicator lights marked OFF, WAIT and ON. When the supply is unsafe it disconnects the appliance. When power returns, the guard waits for a short delay before switching back on, which gives the compressor time to settle. This protects against the damaging quick restart that often happens when electricity comes back after an outage. A bypass button lets you override the guard if you need to. The bundle also includes an Amaze 6-way extension socket with a long white cable and a UK-style plug, so you can power your TV, decoder, phone chargers and other small devices from a single wall point. The sockets are clearly spaced, and the cable is long enough to reach across most rooms. Who needs it: any household or small business with a fridge, freezer, water dispenser or display cooler. In areas where voltage drops or blackouts are common, a guard is a small cost compared with replacing a compressor or losing a freezer full of food, milk or drinks. Pack size: 1 Amaze fridge and freezer guard plus 1 Amaze 6-way extension socket with cable. Colour: white with blue label. Plug type: UK three-pin. Please check the rating printed on the guard against your appliance before you buy, and use the guard for refrigeration appliances as shown on its label. Installation is simple: plug the guard into the wall, plug your fridge into the guard, and wait for the ON light. No tools needed. item.title: Combat Rodent Bait Station 5pcs
item.description: ## Product overview This listing is for five stations. It does not mean five bait blocks are included. Rodent bait is a separate product unless the seller specifically states otherwise. The stations can be used as part of a planned monitoring and control programme in homes, commercial buildings, stores, warehouses and other premises where rodent activity has been identified. ## Product details - Product name: Combat Rodent Bait Station - Pack quantity: 5 pieces - Product type: Rodent-control equipment - Main function: Enclosed placement of rodent bait - Intended use: Multiple bait points within a rodent-management programme - Bait: Not included unless explicitly stated by the seller The pack is intended for buyers who need more than one station and want consistent equipment across several inspection points. Confirm the five-piece quantity and the condition of the units when the order arrives. Accessories, keys, fixing hardware and bait should not be assumed to be included unless they are listed by the seller. ## Why use multiple bait stations? Rodents often move along edges, walls, service routes and sheltered spaces. A site assessment can identify likely travel paths and the locations where monitoring may be useful. Using several stations allows a pest-management plan to cover more than one area and can make inspection records more consistent. Each station should have a defined location, and staff should know who is responsible for checking it. Enclosed stations are designed to reduce casual access to bait by non-target animals and people. The tamper-resistant construction described by the seller is a protective feature, not a guarantee that a station or the bait inside is harmless. Correct placement, secure closure, routine inspection and compliance with the bait label remain essential. ## Planning a five-station setup A five-piece pack may suit a small commercial site, a multi-room property or a buyer who needs several monitoring points. The number and spacing of stations should be based on the layout, rodent evidence and the pest-management plan rather than an arbitrary fixed distance. Do not place stations where food, feed or utensils are handled. Keep them away from children, pets and unauthorised users, and make sure responsible staff know their locations. When comparing a five-piece pack with individual stations, consider the cost per unit, the time needed to inspect each point and whether the same station design is appropriate for all parts of the site. Record each station's position and inspection date. Replace damaged equipment and follow the station manufacturer's instructions for cleaning, securing and maintenance. ## Buying from Stermont Arcade in Kenya For related supplies, browse the [Pest Control and Fumigation category](https://stermontarcade.co.ke/c/pest-control-fumigation.html), the [Agrovet and Farm Supplies category](https://stermontarcade.co.ke/c/agrovet.html), and the [General Merchandise category](https://stermontarcade.co.ke/c/general-merchandise.html). Customers outside Nairobi should confirm courier options, delivery timing and charges before ordering. For help confirming the five-piece pack or combining items, contact WhatsApp support on +254 789 514 060. ## Frequently asked questions ### How many stations are in this pack? The listing is for five Combat Rodent Bait Stations. ### Does the pack include bait? ### Can the stations help protect children and pets? item.title: Non-Toxic Mouse Rat Sticky Glue Trap 2 Pieces
item.description: ## Product overview The Non-Toxic Mouse and Rat Sticky Glue Trap – 2 Pieces is a mechanical rodent-capture product supplied as a two-piece pack. Each board uses a sticky adhesive surface to catch rodents that walk across it. Unlike rodenticide bait, a glue board does not rely on a chemical poison as its active capture method. This listing is for two sticky traps, not a ten-piece pack and not a reusable snap trap. The product listing describes the boards as suitable for placement in areas where rats or mice are commonly seen. The flat format can be positioned along walls, near suspected entry points or in sheltered locations where rodent movement has been observed. Placement should always be selected carefully so the board does not create a hazard for children, pets or non-target wildlife. ## Product details - Product type: Adhesive rodent trap - Pack quantity: 2 pieces - Intended target: Rats and mice, as described by the seller - Capture method: Sticky adhesive surface - Power source: None required - Rodenticide: Not stated as included The product is described as non-toxic and ready to place. This does not mean the trap is risk-free: adhesive can catch non-target animals and can stick to skin, clothing or household surfaces. Read the package instructions and use the product only in locations where it can be monitored and managed responsibly. ## How glue boards fit into rodent control Glue boards are one option within a wider rodent-management plan. They can provide a way to detect or capture rodents in selected indoor locations, particularly where a buyer prefers not to place rodenticide. They do not address the reason rodents entered the building. Food sources, waste, gaps around doors and pipes, clutter and access to water should also be considered. Before placing a board, inspect the area for signs of activity such as droppings, gnaw marks, rub marks or nesting material. Choose a protected location that is not accessible to children, pets or other non-target animals. Keep the board away from food-preparation surfaces, food stores and places where it may be stepped on or handled accidentally. Check the trap regularly in accordance with the package instructions and local animal-welfare requirements. ## Choosing a two-piece pack A two-piece pack can suit a small property, a limited monitoring task or a buyer who wants to position traps at two separate points. The number of boards required depends on the size and layout of the premises and the level of rodent activity. Do not assume that two boards will resolve a larger infestation. For a widespread problem, combine monitoring with proofing, sanitation and professional advice. This page is specifically for the two-piece pack. Other glue-board quantities and other rodent-control products are different listings and may have different prices. Check the quantity shown on the package when your order is delivered. ## Buying from Stermont Arcade in Kenya For related supplies, browse the [Pest Control and Fumigation category](https://stermontarcade.co.ke/c/pest-control-fumigation.html), the [Agrovet and Farm Supplies category](https://stermontarcade.co.ke/c/agrovet.html), and the [General Merchandise category](https://stermontarcade.co.ke/c/general-merchandise.html). item.description:
Romectin 1.8 EC 250ml Price in Kenya

Romectin 1.8 EC is an abamectin-based insecticide and miticide supplied in a 250ml pack. It is used in crop protection programmes where mites and leaf miners are a concern. The 250ml pack is a practical option for growers and professional users who need a clearly identified pack size for planned crop-care work. What Romectin is used for

The Kenyan product listing describes Romectin as a translaminar insecticide with activity against mites and leaf miners on flowers and vegetables. A historical PCPB registered-products entry identifies Romectin as containing abamectin 18g/L and records use against red spider mites on roses and leaf miner on French beans. Use only the approved crop and pest combinations, follow the label's dosage, water volume, re-entry interval and pre-harvest interval, and wear the personal protective equipment specified by the label. Avoid inhalation, skin or eye contact, food contamination and spray drift. Keep the product in its original, labelled container, securely closed and stored as directed, away from children, animals, food and animal feed. Never reuse an empty pesticide container. item.description:
Topcop 50 WP 1kg Price in Kenya

Topcop 50 WP is a protectant fungicide and bactericide manufactured by Osho Chemical Industries. This listing is for the 1kg pack. Osho describes the product as a copper oxychloride formulation that helps prevent infection by interfering with the enzyme system of fungal and bacterial spores. Stermont uses that documented retail amount as the authorized baseline input for its configured four-tier pricing trigger.

What Topcop 50 WP is used for

Osho identifies target diseases including rust, anthracnose, angular leaf spot, bacterial blight, Sclerotinia, early blight and late blight. These are label-led crop-protection uses; suitability depends on the crop, disease, timing and current Kenyan product label. Topcop is a protectant product, so it should be used as part of a sound preventive crop-health programme rather than as a promise to cure every established infection. Confirm that the crop and disease combination is specifically permitted on the container label before use.

Application information

Osho's published product information gives a rate of 50g per 20 litres of water and 2.5kg per hectare. Always treat the current approved container label as the controlling instruction, including any crop-specific variations, water volume, maximum number of applications, re-entry interval and pre-harvest interval. Do not increase concentration or frequency to compensate for poor coverage or severe disease. Use clean, calibrated equipment and follow label directions for mixing, agitation and spray coverage. If the crop or disease is not named on the label, seek advice from a qualified agronomist or licensed agrochemical professional before application.

Why select the 1kg pack

This product page represents one 1kg pack of Topcop 50 WP. Osho's online catalogue also lists other pack options, but those are separate sizes and should not be confused with this SKU. The 1kg option can be useful for growers who have a planned spray programme and can calculate their requirement from the approved label rate. Actual treated area varies with crop, spray volume and programme requirements. Check the pack seal, printed batch details, formulation name and net weight when receiving the product.

Safe storage and responsible use

Read the complete label and safety instructions before handling. Wear the protective clothing and equipment stated on the label, avoid breathing dust and prevent contact with skin and eyes. Prepare spray mixture in a well-ventilated area, away from children, animals, food and animal feed. Do not eat, drink or smoke while handling the product. Keep it in its original closed container in the storage conditions specified by the manufacturer. Prevent contamination of drains, ponds, rivers and other water sources. Never reuse an empty pesticide container; manage empty packaging and leftover spray mixture according to label directions and applicable Kenyan requirements.

Buying Topcop 50 WP in Kenya

When comparing fungicides, match the brand, formulation, active ingredient and pack size.
